SYNTHETIC RESUME - DevOps / SRE Engineer

Summary
Site reliability engineer with 6 years of experience operating Kubernetes clusters, building CI/CD pipelines, and improving observability.

Skills
Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Python

Experience
SRE Engineer, Ecommerce Company (2021-present)
- Operated Kubernetes clusters across multiple production regions.
- Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
- Managed infrastructure as code with Terraform.
- Created Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for latency and error budgets.
- Led incident response and post-incident reviews.

DevOps Engineer, SaaS Startup (2018-2021)
- Containerized legacy services with Docker.
- Automated deployment rollouts and rollbacks.
- Improved monitoring alerts and on-call runbooks.
